entries.title: I don't learn anything on HN anymore, bring back the upvote count
entries.author: wdewind
entries.current_title: I don't learn anything on HN anymore, bring back the upvote count
entries.excerpt: I know 1500 people have said this before, but today I guess I'm the one who hit the boiling point. The value of HN, from the perspective of simply learning, has been destroyed for me since upvotes were hidden. When I first started reading HN I learned a TON very quickly and everyday about completely new stuff, and was able to do so because I could easily sort through the legitimacy of opinions based on their upvotes. Yes, the upvote system wasn't perfect, but it's a piece of
entries.guide_zh: 用户认为隐藏赞数降低了学习价值，呼吁恢复显示。

entries.title: Ask HN: How to stave off decline of HN?
entries.author: pg
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How to stave off decline of HN?
entries.excerpt: I was just asking RiderofGiraffes if he had any suggestions for fixing the decreasing quality of comment threads on HN (http://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=2403449) and it occurred to me that I might as well ask everyone. Anyone have any suggestions? We're on mostly uncharted territory here. The problem has several components: comments that are (a) mean and/or (b) dumb that (c) get massively upvoted.
entries.guide_zh: 站方征求遏制 HN 评论质量下降与恶意内容获赞的办法。

entries.title: Tell HN: Please bring back comment scores
entries.author: Maro
entries.current_title: Tell HN: Please bring back comment scores
entries.excerpt: I miss comment scores. Perhaps we could strike middle ground by displaying a range, eg. 1, 2-5, 5-10, 10+
entries.guide_zh: 怀念评论评分的读者建议恢复显示，或用分数区间折中。

entries.title: Ask HN: Who is Hiring? (April 2011)
entries.author: whoishiring
entries.excerpt: Please lead with the location of the position and include the keywords INTERN, REMOTE, or H1B if the corresponding sort of candidate is welcome. Feel free to post any job HN readers may be interested in from executive assistant to machine learning expert to CTO. Take a look at the freelancer matchmaking thread: http://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=2396088

entries.title: If you applied to YC this cycle, please put your email address in your profile
entries.author: pg
entries.current_title: If you applied to YC this cycle, please put your email address in your profile
entries.excerpt: Tonight we're going to email everyone who applied for summer 2011. We use the email address in the email field of the HN account used to apply. So if you applied, please check that you have a working email address (not foobar AT gmail.com) in the email field of your profile. (That field is not publicly visible, as you can see if you try logging out and looking at your profile.)
entries.guide_zh: YC 即将邮件通知夏季申请结果，提醒检查申请账号里的邮箱字段。

entries.title: Ask HN: Why can't I make as much as I make?
entries.author: nopassrecover
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Why can't I make as much as I make?
entries.excerpt: In "How to Make Wealth" PG puts forward the following argument: 1. Assume a hacker can make a good wage working for someone else. 2. Assume a hacker can in turn be significantly more productive working for themselves. 3. All things being equal, a hacker should be able to make significantly more money by working for themselves (albeit at the cost of increased risk and stress).
